svg.title: Indeed their first two exponents are the last two negative numbers in (WS14); the third uses −a < c, which follows from the last inequality there. Also ajb−1 < rk/(2R) and aje < rkpk eventually, by the two strict panel gaps in (WS14). These two widths are the two centered budgets needed for the shift across a grid tie and for the comparison away from it. The rooted whole-word error is CRεk →0. The moving-chamber decomposition (WS8)–(WS9), with its strip of width pk, is therefore valid jointly in all slots. Integrating it against a test of supremum M gives the station error εM Q i ∥vi∥, including projection ties. This is the actual three-panel route to the joint station statement. The simpler conditions (WS13) record the part of that geometry used by its one-width formulation; no two-field estimate is being used to supply a whole-word centered estimate.
